top_signals.title: Gold Deluge Keeps China’s $1 Trillion Trade Surplus in Check
top_signals.summary: China’s gold imports surged to a record $209 billion so far this year, in an unprecedented buying spree that followed a promise by top officials to make their country into the world’s marketplace instead of just its factory.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Can climate diplomacy build on the collapse of COP31?
top_signals.summary: The failures of this year's talks in Turkey, which follow weak outcomes at earlier COPs, lay bare a need for change.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
